Step: 12 weeks = 84 days.  
84 days + 4 days = 88 days.  
1780 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not century exception because 1780 < 1800).  
From 1780-07-07 add 88 days:  
July has 31 days → remaining in July after 7th: 24 days.  
88 − 24 = 64 days left.  
August has 31 days → 64 − 31 = 33 days left.  
September has 30 days → 33 − 30 = 3 days left → into October.  
New date: 1780-10-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1780-10-04
